provider.label: Service

quick.body: Each image is generated on its own, faster; pick references by hand when needed.

continuity.body: Each image builds on the previous one by default for consistent characters and scenes; you can point to an earlier image instead.

hint.refs: Follows the style, characters and rhythm of reference images, video or audio; the ratio follows the references.
